definitions.short: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best ), beauty , gladness , welfare
definitions.usage: fair, gladness, good(-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.
definitions.full: H2898. tub טוּב noun masculine Job 20:21 good things, goods, goodness ; — ׳ט Gen 24:10 17 t.; suffix טוּבִי Exod 33:19 ; Jer 31:14 ; טוּבְךָ Psa 25:7 4 t.; טוּבוֺ Hosea 3:5 2 t.; טוּבָהּ Neh 9:36 ; Jer 2:7 ; טוּבָם Job 21:15 ; — not in H P, Chronicles, Ezekiel or post-exilic prophets — 1 good things , collective, produce of the land to be eaten Gen 45:18 , 20 , 23 (E), Isa 1:19 ; Jer 2:7 ; Ezra 9:12 ; Neh 9:35-36 , to be enjoyed; good things of ׳י as given by him Hosea 3:5 ; Jer 31:12 , 14 ; Psa 27:13 ; of house of ׳י 65:5 , figurative of spiritual blessings. 2 goods, property Gen 24:10 (J), Deut 6:11 ; 2Kin 8:9 ; Neh 9:25 . 3 abstract: a. fairness, beauty , of neck of heifer Hosea 10:11 ; of people of ׳י Zech 9:17 ; of ׳י himself Exod 33:19 (JE). b. לב(בׅ טוּב joy of heart Deut 28:47 ; Isa 65:14 (see I. טוֺב 2 , II. ׳ט 7 ). c. prosperity Job 20:21 ; 21:16 ; of Jerusalem Psa 128:5 ; צַדִּיקִים בְּטוּב Prov 11:10 in the prosperity of the righteous the city rejoiceth. d. goodness of taste, discernment Psa 119:66 . 4 abstract, goodness of God: a. in bestowing good things Neh 9:25 . b. in the salvation of his people Isa 63:7 ; Psa 25:7 ; 145:7 . c. stored up for his saints Psalm Psa 31:20 .
